close.name: FS_CloseFile
close.result: BOOL in r0; success clears arc, restores command 14, and clears file/dir status bits.

init_file.name: FS_InitFile
init_file.result: Initializes the 72-byte handle in place; command becomes 14 and arc/stat are cleared.

open.name: FS_OpenFileFast
open.result: BOOL in r0; success populates arc, own_id, top, bottom, and pos.

read.name: FS_ReadFile
read.result: Returns bytes read, advances pos by that amount, and returns -1 when synchronous wait fails.

runtime_capture.method: clean boot with DeSmuME ARM9 GDB stub; entry and caller-return breakpoints

seek.name: FS_SeekFile
seek.result: Modes 0/1/2 are SET/CUR/END and clamp to top..bottom; invalid mode returns 0 without changing pos.
